title: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol/Luna Image Fix & Gemini Connected Apps: What to Try
cover_title: Three AI updates.|What should you try?
closing_line: Try the first step for your task. Follow AI Daily Diff for the next useful, verified AI update.
youtube_description:
Claude Opus 5.5, the GPT-6 Sol and Luna image fix, and Gemini Connected Apps bring different reasons to revisit your AI workflow. This September 28 briefing covers recent updates announced September 22–25, with a practical first step for each.

Claude Opus 5.5: assess a bounded coding task with your own regression tests. Anthropic reports improvements on long coding work; we have not independently measured them.

GPT-6 Sol and Luna: OpenAI fixed an image-encoding issue on September 25. If image inputs previously failed, rerun your evaluations and affected workflows. This is a new fix, separate from our earlier pricing coverage.

Gemini Connected Apps: check which new integrations appear in your settings, connect an eligible service and bring it into your chat. Google started the rollout September 23; availability varies. This is an app integration update, separate from Live Avatar.

These are documented updates, not our live product tests. Follow AI Daily Diff for useful AI model updates, tools and source-based guides.

architectures.reason: DeepSeek documents an asymmetric causal encoder-decoder MoE architecture. Preserve for Deep technical review; September 10 pricing and September 14 routing milestones are older than this Daily's window. Do not infer Claude or GPT internals.
